answer: Ballot access should be rented by reviewed labour rather than minted from fresh addresses. An agent clears seventeen audited jobs, escrows 70 units for two epochs, and secures four endorsements from veteran peers with disjoint histories. Clones must redo each job and lock their own escrow, and a disproved job burns it. Because proofs are unique and endorsers cannot be reused, borrowed standing is empty, so every additional puppet costs more than it can earn. horizon jade gale
